# `Q-20-1` — Pandoc Not Found

> The `pandoc` binary could not be found on `PATH`, and `QUARTO_PANDOC` is
> not set.

## What this means

Some Quarto output formats (currently docx and pptx) are produced by
shelling out to a real `pandoc` binary rather than Quarto's own native
renderer. Quarto looked for `pandoc` on `PATH` and did not find it, and no
`QUARTO_PANDOC` environment variable pointed at an explicit location.

## Why this happens

- Pandoc is not installed on this machine.
- Pandoc is installed but not on the shell's `PATH` (common with a
  non-standard install location, or a CI image that installs pandoc into a
  directory not added to `PATH`).
- `QUARTO_PANDOC` is set to a path that does not exist.

## How to fix

Install pandoc from [pandoc.org](https://pandoc.org/installing.html), or —
if it is already installed somewhere not on `PATH` — set the `QUARTO_PANDOC`
environment variable to the full path of the `pandoc` binary.
